region_authority: All region ids verified against Data/soul_world_overmap_v1_20260922.json 'nodes'. No invented regions.

existing_sites_restated.label: VERIFIED FROM CURRENT SNAPSHOT (restated in new schema; NOT re-authored)
existing_sites_restated.note: These three remain under FSoulHeartlandSite / HeartlandDevelopment.json. Shown only to prove backward-compat mapping.

activities.name: North Pass Watchtower
activities.placement_rationale: node north_pass: mountain/pass/narrow_pass -> a chokepoint controlling movement between Heartland and Orc badlands. Natural watchtower.
activities.detour_reason: Clearing grants persistent vision over adjacent neutral regions (reduces fog ambush risk); first cheap 'why leave the capital' hook on Days 1-7.

activities.name: Coastal Ruins
activities.placement_rationale: node coastal_ruins: coast/valley_hill/ruins AND is already listed in six_faction_sandbox_candidate.neutral_minor_sites. Canonical ruins site.

presentation.candidate_owned_pack: Fantasy Ruins (LAYA DESIGN) OR Elite Landscapes: Coastal Ruins (Velarion) - OWNED, LocallyAvailable=true per catalog; import to Soul UNVERIFIED

activities.detour_reason: One-shot treasure cache behind a moderate neutral guard; midgame gold spike that rewards an army detachment.

activities.name: Northwest March Ruins
activities.placement_rationale: node northwest_march: temperate/rolling_plain/trade_road AND listed in neutral_minor_sites. A ruined waystation on a trade road.
activities.detour_reason: Lore/XP site; cheap early hero progression that does not require a full battle (investigate, not clear).

activities.name: Forest Edge Beast Den
activities.placement_rationale: node forest_edge: forest/woodland/grove, adjacent to the Heartland and a value_site_candidate (timber). Natural beast lair blocking a timber site.

presentation.candidate_owned_pack: Creeping Creatures Pack / 10 Creatures (Bugrimov Maksim) - OWNED; import to Soul UNVERIFIED. LOCAL RUNTIME-ASSET CHECK REQUIRED for a usable monster skeletal mesh+anim.

activities.detour_reason: Clearing the den unlocks a value timber site AND seeds a small recruitment pool; links economy and recruitment lanes.

activities.name: Collapsed Mine Shaft
activities.placement_rationale: node old_quarry: temperate/ridge/resource; already hosts heartland.quarry. A deeper cave beneath the quarry (one-shot) sits beside the recurring quarry site WITHOUT altering it.

presentation.candidate_owned_pack: Caves and Dungeons / Fantasy Cave Environment Set / CryptForge - OWNED; import UNVERIFIED

activities.detour_reason: Demonstrates two activities co-located on one region (recurring quarry + one-shot cave) without a schema conflict; rewards holding the region long enough to invest 2 AP.

activities.name: River Ford Toll Post
activities.placement_rationale: node river_ford: temperate/valley/river_crossing. Existing river-crossing battle geography; a controllable toll crossing fits the authored bridge content.
activities.detour_reason: Passive recurring income (like windmill) tied to holding a strategic crossing already modelled for battle; reinforces 'control the map, not just cities'. action_cost 0 because the value is in holding the region, not a daily action.

activities.name: Crossroads Free Company
activities.placement_rationale: node crossroads: temperate/rolling_plain/crossroads; a trade/traffic hub already hosting the windmill. Mercenaries gather where roads meet.

presentation.candidate_owned_pack: RPG Mercenary Character (Artem Dubinin) - OWNED; import UNVERIFIED

activities.detour_reason: A paid, gated recruitment top-up outside the capital barracks; recurring but costs gold-at-collect (handled in InteractActivitySite) so it is not free pool growth. Ties recruitment lane into the map layer.

time_limited_examples.label: DESIGN PROPOSAL - caravan/convoy are event-spawned, not fixed; see event_pool_v0.json
time_limited_examples.note: Caravans and resource convoys are generated as transient activities by the event system with a window_days value, then expire. They are NOT authored as permanent entries here to avoid map clutter and to keep deterministic spawn under the event seed.

coverage_matrix.label: DESIGN PROPOSAL - which activity_kind lands in which Heartland-reachable region
